title: Fix AI smoke test workflow secret conditional
body: ### Motivation - GitHub Actions rejected `.github/workflows/ai_provider_smoke_test.yml` because a step-level `if` referenced `secrets.*`, which is not permitted in `if` expressions. - Exposing raw secret values at the job level increases the blast radius for accidental logging or exfiltration by third-party actions. ### Description - Added job-level `env` mappings using boolean flags (`HAS_ANTHROPIC_KEY` / `HAS_GEMINI_KEY`) derived from the secrets via `${{ secrets.X != '' }}`, instead of exposing raw secret values to all steps. - Updated the integration test step `if` expression to check `env.HAS_ANTHROPIC_KEY == 'true' || env.HAS_GEMINI_KEY == 'true'` instead of `secrets.*`. - Kept the actual API key secret values scoped exclusively to the integration test step's `env`, so third-party actions like `subosito/flutter-action@v2` never have access to them. - Added an implementation plan document at `docs/plans/2026-04-02-07-51-UTC-ai-provider-smoke-test-secret-if-fix.md`. ### Testing - Ran local sanity checks including `git diff`, `nl -ba .github/workflows/ai_provider_smoke_test.yml`, and `git log -1`, which displayed the expected modifications and completed successfully. - No CI workflow execution was run as part of this change; the edits are intended to resolve parsing/validation failures so the workflow can run in GitHub Actions. ------ Codex Task
